<script>
(function(){
  var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';

  /* Guirlande lumineuse : fil en festons + ampoules qui scintillent */
  var COLORS = ['#FFE3A0', '#E8343F', '#FFD36B', '#3E9A62', '#FFF1C9'];
  function drawLights(el){
    var w = el.clientWidth, sag = 22, span = w < 600 ? 110 : 150, n = Math.ceil(w / span);
    span = w / n;
    var svg = document.createElementNS(NS, 'svg');
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + w + ' 60');
    svg.setAttribute('preserveAspectRatio', 'none');
    var d = 'M0 4', bulbs = '', k = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var x0 = i * span, x1 = x0 + span, cx = x0 + span / 2;
      d += ' Q' + cx + ' ' + (4 + sag * 2) + ' ' + x1 + ' 4';
      for (var j = 1; j <= 3; j++) {
        var t = j / 4, x = x0 + span * t, y = 4 + 2 * (1 - t) * t * sag * 2;
        var c = COLORS[k++ % COLORS.length];
        bulbs += '<g class="bulb" style="--t:' + (1.8 + Math.random() * 2).toFixed(2) + 's;--dl:-' + (Math.random() * 3).toFixed(2) + 's">' +
          '<circle cx="' + x + '" cy="' + (y + 9) + '" r="9" fill="' + c + '" opacity=".28"/>' +
          '<rect x="' + (x - 2.2) + '" y="' + (y - 1) + '" width="4.4" height="4" rx="1" fill="#5a4a2a"/>' +
          '<ellipse cx="' + x + '" cy="' + (y + 8) + '" rx="3.6" ry="5.2" fill="' + c + '"/>' +
          '<ellipse cx="' + (x - 1.2) + '" cy="' + (y + 6) + '" rx="1" ry="1.8" fill="#fff" opacity=".7"/></g>';
      }
    }
    svg.innerHTML = '<path d="' + d + '" stroke="#2c3b2f" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/>' + bulbs;
    el.innerHTML = ''; el.appendChild(svg);
  }
  var lights = document.querySelectorAll('.lights');
  function allLights(){ lights.forEach(drawLights); }
  allLights();
  var rt; window.addEventListener('resize', function(){ clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(allLights, 200); });

  /* Neige et paillettes dorées dans l'en-tête */
  var snow = document.querySelector('.snow');
  if (snow && !reduce) {
    for (var i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
      var f = document.createElement('i');
      var s = 3 + Math.random() * 5, gold = Math.random() < .45;
      f.style.width = f.style.height = s + 'px';
      f.style.background = gold ? 'radial-gradient(circle,#FFF4CF,#C9A04A)' : '#fff';
      f.style.boxShadow = gold ? '0 0 6px rgba(201,160,74,.6)' : '0 0 4px rgba(150,130,100,.5)';
      f.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
      f.style.setProperty('--dx', (Math.random() * 80 - 40) + 'px');
      f.style.animationDuration = (10 + Math.random() * 12) + 's';
      f.style.animationDelay = (-Math.random() * 20) + 's';
      snow.appendChild(f);
    }
  }

  /* Apparition au défilement */
  var els = document.querySelectorAll('.rv');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){ if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } });
    }, {rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px'});
    els.forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
  } else {
    els.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('in'); });
  }

  /* Sommaire : section active */
  var links = document.querySelectorAll('.nav a');
  var secs = Array.prototype.map.call(links, function(a){ return document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href')); });
  function onScroll(){
    var y = window.scrollY + 140, idx = -1;
    secs.forEach(function(s, i){ if (s && s.offsetTop <= y) idx = i; });
    links.forEach(function(a, i){ a.classList.toggle('on', i === idx); });
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive: true}); onScroll();

  /* Copier le code cadeau */
  var code = document.querySelector('.code');
  if (code) code.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var label = code.querySelector('em'), txt = code.dataset.code;
    var done = function(){ label.textContent = 'Code copié ✓'; label.classList.add('ok');
      setTimeout(function(){ label.textContent = txt; label.classList.remove('ok'); }, 1800); };
    if (navigator.clipboard) navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(done, function(){});
  });
})();
</script>
</body></html>
